items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: I was with Horace and he was a good friend of Franzella's up in New York. And we used to go fishing.

ctx.x: It was Horace Diaz, Frank Bonero, and myself. Well, Johnny Honigman used to talk about him. He really admired him.

He, uh, was he, I got the, I was with Horace and he was a good friend of Franzella's up in New York. And we used to go fishing. Mm-hmm. He sounded like I'd rather go fishing than eat. And we'd go out there and fish and we'd go fishing and spend the days together. And Horace was, uh, he was, in New York he was like, uh, Eddie, he was the second piano for Eddie Duchin. He played piano with Eddie Duchin's orchestra. And, uh, he is also an arranger for a southern music company. He made a lot of Horace Diaz. They had…
